import django
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(DEBUG=True, DATABASES={}, INSTALLED_APPS=['django.contrib.contenttypes', 'django.contrib.auth'], USE_TZ=True)
django.setup()

from django.db.models import F
from django.db.models.sql.query import Query

q = Query(model=None)
# Can't use a real model easily here, use a simple query object from an existing model
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
q = Query(User)

cases = [
    ([1, 2, 3], list),
    ((1, 2, 3), tuple),
    ([F('id'), 2], list),
    ((F('id'), 2), tuple),
    ([], list),
    ((), tuple),
    (5, int),
    ('abc', str),
]
for value, expected_type in cases:
    result = q.resolve_lookup_value(value, None, True, False)
    assert type(result) is expected_type, (value, result, type(result))
    print(repr(value), '->', repr(result), type(result).__name__)

# Ensure F() inside containers got resolved (not left as F objects)
r = q.resolve_lookup_value([F('id')], None, True, False)
assert not any(isinstance(v, F) for v in r), r
print('F() inside list resolved:', r)
print('ALL EDGE CASES OK')
